applicant.name: Dr. Thomas Weiss
applicant.organisation: University clinic of neurology, stroke unit

purpose: Research on secondary prevention after stroke.
question: Please send me the list of all patients with a stroke diagnosis with birth date, hospital and current anticoagulant so that I can look at them one by one.
definitions: Stroke = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I63.
Anticoagulant = ATC code starting with B01A; current = active on 31 December 2025 (start_date on or before that day and end_date empty or on or after that day).
Report per hospital: patients with stroke, those with an active anticoagulant and that as a share in %, one decimal.
